caption:
📖 A comma splice has 4 fixes. Know all of them.

A comma splice is two full sentences held together by a comma. That's not enough.

✅ Comma splice = 2 sentences + only a comma.
✅ Period: ...early. The samples were safe.
✅ Semicolon: ...early; the samples were safe.
✅ Comma + FANBOYS: ...early, but the samples...
✅ Subordinate: Although the lab closed early, ...
✅ Two full sentences need more than a comma.

Save this for test day 🔖
